aboutme.headline: About me
aboutme.paragraph1: Hey there, I'm André, a junior full-stack developer from near Cologne. I have been building frontends for the longest time, and I enjoy the backend side with Django REST Framework just as much. What drives me is turning everyday problems into simple, useful web applications.
aboutme.paragraph2: I learn from every challenge and keep looking for the clean, efficient solution. Let's collaborate and build something remarkable together!

skills.headline: Skill set
skills.text: I work with modern front-end technologies like Angular and TypeScript and build APIs with Python and Django. I'm always open to learning new tools and adapting to what a project needs.

hosting.title: Hosting and server log files
hosting.text: This website is hosted by [TODO: hosting provider]. When you visit the site, the server automatically stores technical data such as your IP address, browser type and time of access. This is necessary to deliver the website securely (Art. 6 (1) (f) GDPR).

contactForm.title: Contact form
contactForm.text: If you send me a message via the contact form, I process your name, email address and message only to answer your request (Art. 6 (1) (b) GDPR). The data is sent to me by email and deleted as soon as it is no longer needed.

localStorage.title: Local storage
localStorage.text: Your language selection (English/German) is saved in your browser's local storage so that the site remembers it on your next visit. This is technically necessary for the function you requested (§ 25 (2) no. 2 TDDDG). No tracking or analytics tools are used.

fonts.title: Fonts
fonts.text: All fonts are hosted locally on this server. No connection to external font providers is made.

rights.title: Your rights
rights.text: You have the right to access, rectification, erasure, restriction of processing, data portability and to object to the processing of your data (Art. 15–21 GDPR). Just send me an email.

complaint.title: Right to lodge a complaint
complaint.text: You have the right to lodge a complaint with a data protection supervisory authority, for example the State Commissioner for Data Protection and Freedom of Information of North Rhine-Westphalia (LDI NRW).
